Great Steakhouse in the center of downtown HCMC near Ben Thanh Market.
Dec 2023 • Solo
Firstly, the service staff was great, especially Tracy, she explained my food items when it was served to.me.
She is helpful and explained which source to go with.
As for the restaurant the decorations was quite posh and the ambient was nice. The sitting was at the second level and understand there is also a 3rd level and VIP or private room for 8 people.
Now for the foods the Oysters were fresh, the New York clam chowder was nice and steak was great .. I end the lunch with their ice cream desert.
This is a great place for a wonderful lunch or dinner.

Awful experience
Mar 2023 • Friends
Very disappointing meal, after 3 weeks travelling this was definitely the worse experience in Vietnam, no hard copies of the menu, which was difficult as some of the seven people eating had no compatible phone, drinks took a while and very limited options !! , menu was very limited and not everything was available, when the meals arrived, one was cold and had to be taken away for reheating, another one was burnt and was taken back to the kitchen and not replaced as this was the last one, table wasn’t cleared after the mains and we wasn’t offered coffee or desserts, this restaurant is very expensive even more so when you add the 10% service charge. would never recommend anyone to eat here, if you see this place just keep walking past !!! You been warned
